items.topic: Resolve C-009 with an in-client look: does Main Menu > Season Leaderboard show other players and a position number?
items.note: This single observation decides whether the mission's '#1' can be measured on the Season Leaderboard at all. Fold into the P2 in-client checklist.
items.resolution: C-009 closed during the turn-35 sweep without an in-client look. The App Store version history plus r/DLS 1e42njg and 1qz14ir establish that DLS26 exposes no global #1 surface: the DLL leaderboard is BY REGION and performance-based, and the tier ladder is numeric 20->1 with Tier 1 Champion as the ceiling. The masterplan therefore fixes the operational target as Tier 1 Champion in the player's own region, sustained across seasons. The in-client Season Leaderboard check is retained only as a Part G intake item in FIRST_CONTACT_v2.md, and is no longer blocking.
